text: No, this asset is **not deforestation-free**. The evidence shows that **34.5 hectares (7.86% of the asset)** had tree cover (>=30% canopy) in 2000 but was **fully cleared by 2020** (0 hectares remaining, per JRC 2020 data). The asset’s forest cover was entirely lost within the observed period, meeting the definition of deforestation under the given thresholds. The analysis used high-confidence datasets (Hansen GFC and JRC) with strict validation rules, confirming the loss.
